g.text: SmartFix: UML State Machine Diagram (Issue lifecycle)
[open issue of same type within 50 m]
/ score = severity + capped duplicate bonus + aging
«Module» = the only module allowed to make
Every transition is written to issue_status_history.
Rejected and Merged are terminal states added in the
database design so these reports have an end state.
